race.description: Precise Automotive Classic Car Cup Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: BRILLIANT KNIGHT (4) ran on nicely first-up over 1500m at Port Macquarie. Stepped up quickly to 1900m last start at Kempsey and was no match for SOUND AND VISION in heavy going. Still has plenty of improvement in the locker - this looks a lovely third-up scenario. CREATIVE RIGHTEOUS (2) ran a couple of fine races in strong country company then failed to measure up last weekend in a Highway over the mile at Newcastle. Should run this trip and with regular rider Grant Buckley back aboard he looks a genuine threat. LENSMAN (5) led in a strange role for him recently over 1900m at Newcastle and was a spent force soon after straightening. On trial at this trip but at the weights if ridden quietly he is in contention. DANCE DANCE DANCE (8) made late inroads but as never a threat last time out over this distance at Hawkesbury. Hasn't won in ages but is worth throwing in the exotics. PRINCE IS GAME (7) was racing well before floundering in heavy ground at Kempsey last start. Can atone.
